rv.q: Christina Bennington is terrifically energetic as protagonist Veronica, skilfully navigating a clumsily written part that positions her as both the show's sardonic narrator and its conflicted emotional heart.
Yes, Heathers the Musical is 'bad taste'. But it's also, I'm afraid, plain bad.
This Heathers cast really has made the musical their own, elevating this teenage tragedy into a razor-sharp show.
